script_text: This week, Jupiter's fiery transit through your 9th House will force you to rethink everything about fate. On Monday, Uranus squares Jupiter in your 1st House, shattering illusions about security. Tuesday brings Jupiter trine Mercury in the 5th House, unlocking creative energy and revealing your love will bloom. Midweek, Saturn enters your 10th House to oppose Jupiter, triggering your career ambitions. By Thursday, Jupiter enters the 4th House to ground your deep energy into roots. The weekend asks you to step into authentic power. Friday is your power day because Jupiter aligns with Mercury in the 12th House, bringing clarity to your path. Saturday is your worst day because Saturn occupies your 10th House, compressing your career energy. Trust your intuition and take bold action, just knowing the universe is conspiring in your favor. Follow for daily updates to stay aligned with your cosmic path.
